ruled_out_vectors.vector: Malicious SingleProvider hook returns fake price to swap at rigged rate
ruled_out_vectors.why_ruled_out: Pool hook is set by pool creator. LP determined by hook. Attacker creating malicious hook = trading against themselves. No external victim.

ruled_out_vectors.vector: snapPrice sandwich in DynamicHelper — move price during addLiquidity
ruled_out_vectors.why_ruled_out: Guard at DynamicHelper.sol:245 — poolState.liquidity must be 0. No liquidity = nothing to sandwich.

ruled_out_vectors.vector: Direct swap bypasses pricing bounds enforcement (CP-004 variant)
ruled_out_vectors.why_ruled_out: Known finding CP-004. Requires afterSwap flag disabled — token creator's config choice. Tier B, self-inflicted.

ruled_out_vectors.vector: Round-trip rounding extraction in DynamicPool via 100+ tiny swaps
ruled_out_vectors.why_ruled_out: Input rounds UP (getAmount0Delta roundUp=true), output rounds DOWN (roundUp=false). Attacker loses on every round-trip. Standard Uniswap V3 rounding.
calculateFixedInput uses mulDiv (rounds down output). calculateFixedOutput uses mulDivRoundingUp (rounds up input). Both favor pool.

ruled_out_vectors.vector: Flash loan + swap reentrancy: borrow tokens, swap to move price, exploit distortion
ruled_out_vectors.why_ruled_out: Flash loan flag (bit 11) doesn't overlap swap flags (bits 2-6) — swaps allowed during callback, by design. No profit path: attacker's own swaps cause IL+fees, no asymmetry found.

ruled_out_vectors.vector: Flash loan fee token denomination mismatch — fee in cheap token for expensive loan
ruled_out_vectors.why_ruled_out: feeToken determined by token's hook (set by token creator). Attacker can't control unless token creator = no victim.

ruled_out_vectors.vector: Stale oracle in SingleProvider pricing hook — buy cheap with outdated valuation
ruled_out_vectors.why_ruled_out: AMM has no built-in oracle. All pricing delegated to hooks. Oracle quality is hook developer's responsibility, not protocol bug.

ruled_out_vectors.vector: Bypass slippage/deadline to execute swap at worse-than-expected price
ruled_out_vectors.why_ruled_out: limitAmount enforced in _finalizeSwapCollectFundsAndDisburse (L2156 input, L2171 output). Deadline validated at entry.

ruled_out_vectors.vector: Transient storage cross-swap stale read for pricing bounds bypass
ruled_out_vectors.why_ruled_out: Known CP-004. DIRECT_SWAP_BEFORE_SWAP_AMOUNT_SLOT is global. Requires specific token flag misconfiguration (beforeSwap enabled, afterSwap disabled).

theft_theses.thesis: Flash loan -> self-trade on CLOB at extreme price -> AMM reads distorted state -> extract on AMM
snapPrice in addLiquidity allows arbitrary price movement -> sandwich around snapPrice
SingleProviderPoolType trusts external pricing hook -> oracle spoof via controlled hook
Direct swap bypasses pricing bounds checked by hooks -> execute at extreme price
theft_theses.victim: Token holders affected by unchecked direct swap pricing

theft_theses.thesis: Dust-loop extraction via 100+ tiny swaps exploiting rounding
